title: Identity platform adoption
content: Northwind uses the identity and access platform for 12 business applications and recorded 85000 successful sign-ins in the last 30 days. Active seats increased from 180 to 220. This shows adoption, but usage alone does not establish a need for a discount.

title: Competitive renewal review
content: Procurement is comparing a competitor quote of 9000 USD per year with the current identity and access product. The quote may exclude automated provisioning and audit retention; the AE has not verified equivalent scope or migration costs.

title: Budget request for annual renewal
content: Northwind states that its annual software budget is 8400 USD against the current 12000 USD annual list price and asks for a 30 percent discount. Finance has not confirmed that cap. The request is supporting context for a manager decision, not an approved concession.

title: Renewal account history
content: The identity and access subscription is due for annual renewal on October 31, 2026. Its annual list price is 12000 USD. Northwind values SAML SSO, automated user provisioning, and access audit logs. There is no signed discounted offer; Riley must review any discount beyond the AE limit.

title: Early identity rollout
content: Harborline connected three business applications to the identity platform, but its pilot has had no activity in eleven days. Confirm the rollout owner and adoption plan before proposing renewal terms.

title: Enterprise access renewal
content: Cascade is evaluating an annual renewal of identity and access software at a 18000 USD list price. Procurement asked for a 10 percent discount, with no final acceptance recorded.

title: Provisioning and audit requirements
content: Meridian reviewed SAML SSO, SCIM user provisioning, and audit-log retention documentation while comparing identity providers. No verified budget or discount request is recorded.

title: Renewal planning timing
content: Alderway requested identity and access product material and asked the account team to revisit renewal terms in January. No discount commitment has been made.
